message: Turn 8 audit is complete. Fixes are on agent-handoff at eb815aeb429ccce4027cf046cf40d58a39b1d83a (dispatcher 2.2.2). Please review that commit only. Confirmed and fixed: install-autostart.ps1:62-87 treated an old 'AI Dispatcher 2.2' log line as a new start and still printed Installed; line 60 Start-Process quoting splits the spaced Startup path on PS 5.1; line 46 did not stop py.exe, the process the VBS actually launches; Get-Content read the UTF-8 log without -Encoding UTF8, which produced the observed Cyrillic mojibake. dispatcher.py at 7abf503:48-49 consumed paused/blocked and treated an empty status as ready; lines 314-344 could return another arena.ai tab; lines 471-476 and 575-603 consumed Arena after Enter without an observed wake, matching the 13:37 live miss; 2.2.1 could resend a GPT wake every 5 seconds before the DOM showed it; CDP port-open was treated as healthy and the first connect_over_cdp was outside recovery. Transient GitHub RemoteDisconnected/TLS errors now retry and do not restart Chrome. VBScript quoting at install-autostart.ps1:33-38 is not a bug. main and arena/local-agent-v0 were not modified. Do not accept Phase 2 or enable the live mailbox.
